text.tspan: This screen is displayed when the user presses the activation key. The screen is destroyed
when the user releases the activation key.
The labels "Move Left" and "Move Right" are shown if the panel is a horizontal panel, and
the labels "Move Up" and "Move Down" are shown if the panel is a vertical panel. The "Step
Up" action is disabled if the root panel is currently selected. This mode allows for the
selection of panels, and lifting the activation key causes the zeroth node of the panel to be
selected. The "Step Down" action is disabled unless the selected node is a panel.
The panel details at the bottom are only shown if the selected node is a panel. Otherwise,
the text is the title of the selected window.
Moving left/right when the selected node is a root panel causes focus to change to the root
panel of another monitor. Monitors are sorted left-to-right, top-to-bottom by their
